selection_note: Source-backed, add-only companion pack. These are instruction files; no runtime dependencies are installed.

skills.name: ztx14-best-motion-ai-kit-for-agents
skills.title: Use the official Motion AI Kit and MCP deliberately
skills.description: Evaluate and document the official Motion AI Kit skill and hosted MCP for the project’s coding agent without silently changing project or agent configuration.
skills.use: The task needs current Motion API documentation, usage examples, or an agent-side Motion skill. This is especially useful for Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, Gemini CLI, Amp, and OpenCode workflows.

skills.name: ztx14-best-motion-docs-api-version-gate
skills.title: Gate Motion examples on the installed API version
skills.description: Prevent agents from copying current Motion APIs into older projects without checking package versions and migration requirements.
skills.use: Any Motion implementation, refactor, or use of newly documented hooks/components.

skills.name: ztx14-best-animation-engine-selection
skills.title: Choose CSS, Motion, GSAP, or the existing Isometric engine
skills.description: Select the smallest animation tool that fits the interaction and assign one owner to each animated property.
skills.use: Before introducing an animation library or implementing a new effect on an Isometric component.

skills.name: ztx14-best-motion-values-no-rerender
skills.title: Drive high-frequency motion with Motion Values
skills.description: Implement cursor-follow and continuous gestures without setting React state on every pointer movement.
skills.use: Pointer-follow, tilt, magnetic effects, live velocity, scroll-linked values, and any high-frequency visual value.

skills.name: ztx14-best-motion-transform-mapping
skills.title: Map pointer coordinates to bounded visual responses
skills.description: Map local pointer coordinates and velocity to limited rotation, depth, highlight, or parallax with stable reset behavior.
skills.use: Isometric-adjacent DOM cards, overlays, labels, or decorative layers; not as a replacement for figure hit-testing.

skills.name: ztx14-best-motion-exit-presence
skills.title: Animate enter/exit without leaving stale DOM or state
skills.description: Use Motion presence patterns to animate conditional React content while keeping keys and state transitions correct.
skills.use: Panels, tooltips, menus, object details, modals, badges, and route-adjacent overlays whose exit should finish after state changes.

skills.name: ztx14-best-motion-layout-shared-elements
skills.title: Animate layout changes and shared visual identity
skills.description: Use layout animation for reorder, resize, and shared-element transitions without manually animating competing position values.
skills.use: Lists, tabs, selected object details, cards moving between regions, and UI that changes layout after selection.

skills.name: ztx14-best-motion-svg-path-and-viewbox
skills.title: Animate SVG drawing and viewBox safely
skills.description: Create SVG line-drawing and camera-like framing effects while preserving viewBox, hit regions, labels, and layout stability.
skills.use: Isometric diagram reveals, route pulses, line-draw illustrations, and SVG camera framing.

skills.name: ztx14-best-gsap-react-context-cleanup
skills.title: Use GSAP in React with context and revert cleanup
skills.description: Scope imperative GSAP timelines to the component lifecycle and reliably revert animations when dependencies or breakpoints change.
skills.use: Complex scroll stories and orchestrated timelines where GSAP is clearly more appropriate than declarative Motion.

skills.name: ztx14-best-scroll-animation-ownership
skills.title: Select one scroll-animation owner and preserve native scroll
skills.description: Choose native CSS, Motion useScroll, or GSAP ScrollTrigger based on scroll choreography complexity and fallback requirements.
skills.use: Parallax, progress indicators, scroll reveals, sticky panels, and multi-section narratives.

skills.name: ztx14-best-pointer-capture-cancel-lifecycle
skills.title: Handle pointer capture, cancellation, and lost input
skills.description: Make drag and press interactions robust to pointer leaving the target, browser cancellation, and interrupted device input.
skills.use: Dragging isometric objects, sliders, world panning, custom handles, and any interaction that spans beyond the initial hit target.

skills.name: ztx14-best-touch-scroll-gesture-arbitration
skills.title: Resolve drag versus page-scroll gesture conflicts
skills.description: Design mobile interactions that do not trap vertical scrolling or turn a hover-only action into an unusable touch gesture.
skills.use: Touch controls for panning/zooming a world, interactive SVG, carousels, draggable isometric components, and stylus support.

skills.name: ztx14-best-resize-observer-loop-prevention
skills.title: Use ResizeObserver without layout feedback loops
skills.description: Adapt an isometric scene to its container without causing resize-loop warnings or read/write layout churn.
skills.use: Responsive SVG viewBox, canvas sizing, embedded panels, container-aware motion, and split-pane layouts.

skills.name: ztx14-best-offscreen-motion-pause
skills.title: Pause expensive animation when it is not visible
skills.description: Use visibility and intersection signals to suspend nonessential animation work for offscreen scenes and hidden tabs.
skills.use: Large SVG worlds, animated illustrations below the fold, interactive scenes inside tabs, and expensive decorative motion.

skills.name: ztx14-best-motion-bundle-budget-lazymotion
skills.title: Keep Motion bundle cost proportional to the features used
skills.description: Use Motion’s lightweight feature-loading options where appropriate and avoid shipping unused animation features.
skills.use: Production bundles, landing pages, interactive Isometric demos, and apps where only a small subset of Motion is required.

skills.name: ztx14-best-animation-performance-trace
skills.title: Profile animation in the browser instead of guessing
skills.description: Use browser performance traces and rendering diagnostics to isolate jank in pointer and SVG interactions.
skills.use: Reports of stutter, frame drops, high CPU/GPU, delayed cursor-follow, or animation that degrades on mobile.

skills.name: ztx14-best-interaction-input-latency
skills.title: Keep pointer feedback responsive under main-thread work
skills.description: Reduce input delay by keeping pointer handlers lightweight and measuring end-to-end interaction responsiveness.
skills.use: Delayed hover/highlight, cursor-follow lag, heavy SVG picking, menus that open late, and motion that degrades during app work.

skills.name: ztx14-best-visual-regression-determinism
skills.title: Make animation visual regression tests deterministic
skills.description: Stabilize screenshots for animation-heavy UI with controlled timing, fonts, assets, viewport, and reduced-motion conditions.
skills.use: Playwright screenshot baselines, Storybook visual tests, CI screenshot diffs, or flaky animation assertions.

skills.name: ztx14-best-browser-device-test-matrix
skills.title: Test interactions across input and viewport capability classes
skills.description: Build a focused test matrix for fine/coarse pointers, keyboard, reduced motion, orientation, and small viewports.
skills.use: Any new responsive animation, drag mechanic, pointer-follow effect, isometric world control, or component release.

skills.name: ztx14-best-a11y-axe-plus-manual-review
skills.title: Combine automated accessibility scans with manual interaction review
skills.description: Use axe-core or Storybook a11y checks as a first pass, then manually verify keyboard, focus, semantics, and spatial interaction alternatives.
skills.use: Interactive SVG, custom controls, Isometric objects, hover details, drag controls, modals, menus, and reusable component releases.

skills.name: ztx14-best-keyboard-equivalent-spatial-control
skills.title: Give spatial object interactions keyboard equivalents
skills.description: Make isometric selection, navigation, drag, and world controls usable without a mouse or precise pointer movement.
skills.use: Selectable buildings, SVG diagrams, drag-and-drop placement, panning/zooming, layered figures, or objects that respond to hover.

skills.name: ztx14-best-ssr-hydration-animation-determinism
skills.title: Keep initial animation and SVG markup SSR-safe
skills.description: Avoid hydration mismatches and first-paint jumps when animated React/SVG components are server-rendered.
skills.use: Next.js or other SSR/hydrated React projects, random decorative layouts, measurement-dependent transforms, and first-load transitions.

skills.name: ztx14-best-css-container-query-motion
skills.title: Adapt animation to the component container, not only the viewport
skills.description: Use container queries and ResizeObserver intentionally so a component behaves well when embedded in narrow panels or split layouts.
skills.use: Reusable Isometric cards, side panels, dashboards, documentation embeds, resizable workspaces, and responsive components inside grids.

skills.name: ztx14-best-svg-layer-hit-region-budget
skills.title: Optimize SVG layer count and semantic hit regions
skills.description: Keep large SVG scenes responsive by separating decorative geometry from stable interaction targets and limiting unnecessary live nodes.
skills.use: Large isometric worlds, SVG dashboards, dense diagrams, complex outlines, and object picking that slows as scene complexity grows.

skills.name: ztx14-best-agent-implementation-evidence-loop
skills.title: Run a bounded implement-test-review loop for UI agents
skills.description: Give coding agents a concrete acceptance contract for motion tasks so every implementation has observable evidence and no fabricated verification.
skills.use: Agent-driven UI implementation, multi-agent workflows, animation bug fixes, design-to-code tasks, and automated repair loops.
